svg.aria-label: Operator console for Krishna Puri, systems engineer. Status online. Left panel: operator license with photo slot and an XP bar with five of six segments earned, the last deliberately open. Right panel: terminal with the working rule — trade-offs named, claims receipted, CI re-proves — and a status grid: VoltHub CI six jobs on both engines, Q-Trust CI eleven workflows, security audit and CodeQL gated, two docs sites, ten tagged releases, zero known CVEs.
